verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows that LaunchDarkly's core flag-management platform publishes its source under an open license. The only open-source mentions are community remarks about the Relay Proxy, a peripheral Go component that runs on your infrastructure. That is adjacent, not the product's own source, and no license is documented for it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
